description: This file defines the ProgramTable class and its nested Observer class, which manage MPEG program data, observers, and related operations within the WPEFramework's Broadcast namespace. It includes methods for registering/unregistering observers, querying program information, and handling MPEG sections.

classes.name: ProgramTable
classes.description: Manages MPEG program data, observers, and related operations within the WPEFramework's Broadcast namespace. Implements singleton pattern and provides methods for observer registration, program data retrieval, and NIT PID management.

classes.name: ProgramTable::Observer
classes.description: Nested class that observes MPEG sections related to a specific program, handling section data and notifying the parent ProgramTable.

methods.name: Instance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of ProgramTable.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Registers an observer callback for a specific keyId and returns a pointer to the ISection interface.

methods.name: Program
methods.description: Checks if a program with given keyId and programId exists and updates the provided pmt if different.

methods.name: NITPid
methods.description: Retrieves the NIT PID associated with a given keyId.

methods.name: Key
methods.description: Generates a unique key from keyId and programId for internal storage.

methods.name: AddProgram
methods.description: Adds or updates a program entry in the internal store.
